metric.name: Total Number of Allowances in Circulation

subject_ref.label: EU Emissions Trading System carbon market

legal_relevance.statement: Decision (EU) 2015/1814 makes the most recently published TNAC the numeric input for Market Stability Reserve placement/release rules.

forbidden_inferences: The TNAC value is itself a textual mutation of Decision (EU) 2015/1814.
The observation owns the resulting reserve-placement quantity.
The publication date of the metric is the downstream application date.
notes: System-wide official metric proof case for Issue #79.
